استلمنا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَلَمْنَا (istalamnā) /is.ta.lam.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# اُسْتُلِمْنَا (ustulimnā) /us.tu.lim.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
